propers.text:
Quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, qui caelestia alimenta percepimus,
intercedente beato Romano Martyre tuo, per haec contra omnia adversa
muniamur. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Leaf n1143, printed p. 1151, under `Commemoration of St. Romanus` and `Postcommunion` at the end of the Vigil of St Lawrence. The facing Latin is the 1962 slot's prayer, with Romanus printed by name in both columns.

translations.text: We beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have partaken of the food of heaven may, by the intercession of blessed Romanus, Thy martyr, be strengthened by it against all harm. Through our Lord.
